title: 第一卷 第4章 我的人，睡了就跑
content_zh:
童喻回想起刘老板脸上的血，再看向眼前神色自若的男人，她真的怀疑他住手只是因为酒瓶只有那么点。

    他那股狠劲，让她认清他的名声不是白来的。

    霍放站在她面前，微微挑眉，“怕了？”

    童喻摇头。

    “也是。你向来胆子大，比如昨天，睡了我就跑。”

    “二少总不是希望让我负责吧？”

    霍放挑眉，吸着烟斜睨着她，“我玩得起，就怕你玩不起。”

    童喻听出了弦外之音。

    从头到尾都是她在招他，一个人玩想什么时候停就什么时候停。

    两个人玩，她没有叫停的权利了。

    有人敲门。

    霍放看向门口，“进。”

    门推开，宋源走进来，手上拿了一个医药箱，还有冰袋。

    “童小姐还有没有别处受伤，要不要去医院检查一下？”

    童喻摇头，“没事。”

    “那用这个敷一下脸。”

    “谢谢。”

    宋源又看向霍放，主动认错，“二少，今晚让童小姐受惊了。以后这种事情不会再发生了。”

    童喻手拿着冰袋，正准备放脸上。

    霍放对她勾了勾手。

    她疑惑着迈开脚，脚有点痛，硬是走得稳稳当当。

    霍放灭了烟，拉着她坐下，扶着她的肩膀侧向他，拿过她手上的冰袋，贴放在她的左脸上。

    冰凉的触感和他呼吸带出来的烟味让她身体不由绷紧。

    深邃暗沉的眸子凝视着童喻被打得发红的脸，他微微张唇，“宋老板不敢得罪刘昌。所以就选择让我的人去担惊受怕？”

    宋源脸色微变，低下了头，“对不起。”

    童喻内心有些震惊。
content_en:
Tong Yu recalled the blood on Boss Liu's face, and then looked at the calm-looking man in front of her. She really suspected that he stopped just because there was only so much wine in the bottle.

    His fierceness made her realize that his reputation was not for nothing.

    Huo Fang stood in front of her, raising his eyebrows slightly, "Are you scared?"

    Tong Yu shook his head.

    "That's right. You've always been brave. For example, yesterday, you ran away from me when you fell asleep."

    "Second Young Master, you don't want me to be responsible, do you?"

    Huo Fang raised his eyebrows, puffing on his cigarette and squinting at her, "I can afford it, but I'm afraid you can't."

    Tong Yu heard the underlying meaning.

    She was recruiting him from the beginning to the end, and she could stop playing alone whenever she wanted.

    When two people are playing, she has no right to stop.

    There was a knock on the door.

    Huo Fang looked at the door and said, "Come in."

    The door opened and Song Yuan walked in, holding a medical kit and an ice pack.

    "Is Miss Tong injured elsewhere? Do you want to go to the hospital for a check-up?"

    Tong Yu shook his head, "It's okay."

    "Then use this on your face."

    "Thank you."

    Song Yuan looked at Huo Fang again and took the initiative to admit his mistake, "Second Young Master, I frightened Miss Tong tonight. This kind of thing will never happen again in the future."

    Tong Yu held an ice pack in his hand and was about to put it on his face.

    Huo Fang hooked his hand at her.

    She stepped forward doubtfully, her feet hurt a little, but she walked steadily.

    Huo Fang put out the cigarette, pulled her to sit down, held her shoulders and turned to him, took the ice pack in her hand, and placed it on her left cheek.

    The cold touch and the smell of smoke from his breath made her body tense up.

    His deep and dark eyes stared at Tong Yu's beaten red face, and he opened his lips slightly, "Boss Song does not dare to offend Liu Chang. So you choose to let my people worry?"

    Song Yuan's face changed slightly and he lowered his head, "I'm sorry."

    Tong Yu was a little shocked inside.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 4 My people run away when they fall asleep
